description: This PHP source file defines the Vtiger_SalesOrderPDFController class, which extends the InventoryPDFController class to facilitate the generation of PDF documents related to sales orders within the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for building header models with sales order details, retrieving header viewers, and formatting specific sections of the PDF such as address and date information.

classes.name: Vtiger_SalesOrderPDFController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for generating PDF representations of sales orders, including header information such as subject, customer details, addresses, and dates.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelTitle
methods.description: Constructs and returns the title for the sales order PDF header, combining the translated sales order module label with the sales order number.

methods.name: getHeaderViewer
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of SalesOrderPDFHeaderViewer configured with the current header model.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelColumnLeft
methods.description: Builds the left column of the header model, including the quote name associated with the sales order.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelColumnCenter
methods.description: Builds the center column of the header model, including subject, customer name, contact name, and purchase order details.

methods.name: buildHeaderModelColumnRight
methods.description: Builds the right column of the header model, including issued date, due date, billing address, and shipping address.

methods.name: getWatermarkContent
methods.description: Retrieves the sales order status to be used as a watermark in the PDF.
